label: D1 after an unrewarded common a1->S1 trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2). Strongly side-specific: 78% of mass follows a previous a1 choice (prev a2 gives 4%), mostly common a1->S1 transitions, and is biased to unrewarded previous trials (81% of mass at in_rew 0). Best predicate, D1 after common a1->S1 with no reward, uses only observed variables: dev P 0.49 R 0.45 F1 0.47 mass 0.64. Broader D1 & prev a1 common gets recall 0.77 / mass 0.78 but precision 0.18. Some of the misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial lies outside the window. Others are D1 after rare a2->S1 unrewarded (so possibly S1-unrewarded) or after rewarded a1 trials (weaker). Activity also co-occurs with a moderately positive a1 policy logit (choice 2.8 to 8.1 holds 88% of mass, never at strongly a1 or a2) and mid value. It is more frequent early and mid episode (trials 3-49) than late (trials 50-99), and inactive on many matching late-episode steps. Upcoming-action or next_stay conditions did not improve F1. No future variable is used.
